decision_delta: The validated portable guard derives canonical identity from the selected target upstream/base, and the Stop hook automatically enforces the sole active target-worktree V2 claim while preserving the Tenn fallback and legacy V1 silence.
invalidation_conditions: The portable guard no longer derives canonical identity from selected_base().
The hook no longer selects exactly one non-stale target-worktree V2 claim or stops failing closed on ambiguous/invalid matching selectors.
Legacy V1 shared-registry jobs begin triggering automatic closeout enforcement.
reopen_conditions: A materially different selected upstream/base form exposes a new canonical identity failure.
A materially different active-registry selector exposes a new cross-worktree hook failure.
The guard/hook source or evidence hash changes.
